description: Convert the referral system from a hidden surcharge model to a Bonus Balance model. Nobody loses real money: the shop owner does not pay extra, the referred user does not pay extra. Instead, when a referred user makes a purchase, the referrer earns a small Bonus Balance (usable only as a discount on future purchases, cannot be withdrawn). Use the existing bonus system (get_bonus, set_bonus, use_bonus, compute_bonus_usage). Also update compute_bonus_usage to support a wildcard '*' in allowed_products so referral bonus works on ALL products.
steps: Modify compute_bonus_usage() (line ~877) to check for '*' wildcard: if '*' is in bonus.get('allowed_products', []), allow bonus usage on any product. Change the condition from 'if pid in bonus.get("allowed_products", [])' to 'if ("*" in bonus.get("allowed_products", []) or pid in bonus.get("allowed_products", []))' so bonus works universally for referral rewards.
Remove get_referral_surcharge() function entirely (lines ~932-948). It calculated hidden surcharge on buyers.

Modify pay_referral_commission() (lines ~951-990): Instead of crediting real balance via update_balance(), add to referrer's bonus balance using get_bonus() and set_bonus(). The commission amount stays the same (referral_bonus_pct % of purchase), but goes to bonus not real balance. Update the notification message to say 'Bonus Balance' instead of 'credited to your balance'. Remove the 'referral_costs' db_push logging. Keep add_referral_earning() for tracking.

In the purchase confirmation flow (around line 4679-4681): Remove the hidden referral surcharge logic. Remove 'ref_surcharge = await get_referral_surcharge(uid, remaining_cost)' and change 'actual_deduct = round(remaining_cost + ref_surcharge, 4)' to simply 'actual_deduct = remaining_cost'. The buyer now pays exactly the product price (minus any bonus), no hidden extra.
Update the referral info display (if any) to show bonus earned instead of balance earned. Search for where referral total_earned is displayed and update text to clarify it is Bonus Balance.

In pay_referral_commission(): when adding bonus, get current bonus first with get_bonus(referrer_uid), then set new amount = current_bonus['amount'] + commission, and use allowed_products=['*'] so the bonus works on all products. Use set_bonus(referrer_uid, new_amount, ['*']).
acceptance_criteria: pay_referral_commission() uses set_bonus() instead of update_balance()
Purchase flow does not add any surcharge - buyer pays exact product price minus any personal bonus
Referrer notification mentions 'Bonus Balance' not regular balance
verification: grep 'get_referral_surcharge' bot.py should return no matches
grep 'referral_costs' bot.py should return no matches
grep 'set_bonus' bot.py should show usage in pay_referral_commission
grep 'ref_surcharge' bot.py should return no matches
